# Command reference

Every verb of this build of heo, generated from its capability manifest (`heo spec`) and its command
tree. For what a verb does in prose, see [commands](commands.md); for the verbs the grammar names
and this build lacks, see [Grammar coverage](#grammar-coverage).

## How to read the tables

| Column | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| Effect | kit's `kit/side-effect` tier, then `kit/idempotent` (`yes`, `no`, `conditional`: replays under an `--idempotency-key`), then `dry-run` when `--dry-run` is honoured |
| Runs in | `daemon`: executes in the profile's daemon, exit 70 with none running. `local`: executes in the invoking process |
| Roles | who may run it: the authorization roles (see [authorization](authorization.md)), `host user` for the daemon's own lifecycle and store, `none (offline)` for a verb that needs no daemon, store or role |
| uma | the uma call behind the verb; `none` says what backs it instead |
| Limit | where a served surface refuses it: `terminal only` never served, `socket only` destructive or management, `not on REST, gRPC or MCP` streams. `-`: heo declares no limit; discovery on a running daemon is the authority |

## Verbs

### adapter

| Verb | Does | Effect | Runs in | Roles | uma | Limit |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `heo adapter get` | Show one adapter's declarations | `read`, idempotent yes | local | none (offline) | none: this binary's adapter registry | - |
| `heo adapter list` | List the installed adapters, their maturity and capabilities | `read`, idempotent yes | local | none (offline) | none: this binary's adapter registry | - |

```sh
# Basic use
heo adapter get smtp.mail
# JSON for agents
heo adapter get native.webwidget --format json
# Basic use
heo adapter list
# JSON for agents
heo adapter list --format json
```

### attachment

| Verb | Does | Effect | Runs in | Roles | uma | Limit |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `heo attachment download` | Download an attachment's bytes to a file or stdout | `read`, idempotent yes | daemon | desk, viewer, external | Attachments.Open | - |
| `heo attachment get` | Show one attachment's metadata | `read`, idempotent yes | daemon | desk, viewer, external | Attachments.Open (metadata only) | - |

### channel

| Verb | Does | Effect | Runs in | Roles | uma | Limit |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `heo channel authorize` | Run a mailbox's first consent and keep its refresh token | `write`, idempotent no, dry-run | local | operator | none: kit's PKCE loopback login, the credential backend; channel get | terminal only |
| `heo channel check` | Check a channel's configuration, locally or against its provider | `read`, idempotent yes | daemon | operator | Configuration.ChannelByKey, adapter validation; --remote opens the adapter | - |
| `heo channel create` | Create a channel: a configured connection to a provider | `write`, idempotent conditional, dry-run | daemon | operator | Configuration.ConfigureChannel | - |
| `heo channel get` | Show one channel and the provider verbs it supports | `read`, idempotent yes | daemon | operator | Configuration.ChannelByKey | - |
| `heo channel list` | List the profile's channels | `read`, idempotent yes | daemon | operator | Configuration.Channels | - |
| `heo channel update` | Change a channel at the revision you read | `write`, idempotent conditional, dry-run | daemon | operator | Configuration.ConfigureChannel (with expected revision) | - |

```sh
# Preview with --dry-run, change nothing
heo channel authorize gmail --client-id 1234.apps.googleusercontent.com --client-secret-ref gmail-client --dry-run
# With --client-id, --client-secret-ref
heo channel authorize gmail --client-id 1234.apps.googleusercontent.com --client-secret-ref gmail-client
# With --client-id, --directory
heo channel authorize outlook --client-id 6a1b0c9d-0000-4000-8000-000000000000 --directory organizations
# With --no-browser
heo channel authorize gmail --no-browser
# Basic use
heo channel check
# With --remote
heo channel check support-mail --remote
# JSON for agents
heo channel check support-mail --remote --format json
# With --type, --key, --configuration, --credential-ref
heo channel create --type native.webwidget --key web --configuration '{"sites":["site-1"]}' --credential-ref widget-key
# Preview with --dry-run, change nothing
heo channel create --type smtp.mail --key support-mail --configuration "$(cat smtp.json)" --credential-ref smtp-relay --dry-run
# Basic use
heo channel get support-mail
# JSON for agents
heo channel get support-mail --format json
# Basic use
heo channel list
# JSON for agents
heo channel list --format json --limit 10
# With --revision, --credential-ref
heo channel update support-mail --revision rev_123 --credential-ref smtp-relay-2
# Preview with --dry-run, change nothing
heo channel update support-mail --revision rev_123 --configuration "$(cat smtp.json)" --dry-run
```

### config

| Verb | Does | Effect | Runs in | Roles | uma | Limit |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `heo config get` | Print one effective configuration value | `read`, idempotent yes | local | none (offline) | none: kit configuration layers | - |
| `heo config list` | List effective configuration with origins | `read`, idempotent yes | local | none (offline) | none: kit configuration layers | - |
| `heo config path` | Print the highest-precedence existing heo config file | `read`, idempotent yes | local | none (offline) | none: kit configuration layers | - |
| `heo config paths` | Print the full heo config resolution chain | `read`, idempotent yes | local | none (offline) | none: kit configuration layers | - |
| `heo config set` | Write one configuration value | `write`, idempotent yes, dry-run | local | none (offline) | none: writes the profile file | - |
| `heo config validate` | Check the effective configuration | `read`, idempotent yes | local | none (offline) | none: settings and adapter validation; channel check through a running daemon | - |

```sh
# Basic use
heo config get services.socket.path
# JSON for agents
heo config get runtime.tenant --format json
# Basic use
heo --profile aps:noor config get services.socket
# Basic use
heo config list
# JSON for agents
heo --profile work config list --format json
# Where the profile's configuration file lives
heo config path
# For another profile
heo --profile work config path
# Every layer the configuration is read from
heo config paths
# JSON for agents
heo config paths --format json
# Basic use
heo config set services.socket.path /tmp/heo-work.sock
# Basic use
heo --profile work config set runtime.tenant acme
# With --scope
heo config set --scope user services.all.rate_limit.enabled false
# Basic use
heo config validate
# JSON for agents
heo --profile aps:noor config validate --format json
```

| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |

### delivery

| Verb | Does | Effect | Runs in | Roles | uma | Limit |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `heo delivery get` | Show a delivery's state, failure and retry advice | `read`, idempotent yes | daemon | desk, operator | Operations.Get | - |
| `heo delivery list` | List the deliveries of the writes you submitted, newest change first | `read`, idempotent yes | daemon | desk, operator | Operations.List (outbound kinds, the caller's own) | - |

| Verb | Does | Effect | Runs in | Roles | uma | Limit |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `heo hook dead-letter drop` | Give up on a dead letter: its event is never delivered again | `destructive-local`, idempotent yes, dry-run | daemon | operator | none: the hooks service's dead-letter store | socket only |
| `heo hook dead-letter list` | List the events plugins did not handle | `read`, idempotent yes | daemon | operator | none: the hooks service's dead-letter store | - |
| `heo hook dead-letter retry` | Queue running a dead-lettered event through its plugin again | `write-local`, idempotent yes, dry-run | daemon | operator | Events.Get as the plugin; queues a job that runs the plugin and applies its operations | - |
| `heo hook job get` | Show the state and outcome of a queued retry or replay | `read`, idempotent yes | daemon | operator | none: the hooks service's in-memory jobs | - |
| `heo hook list` | List the hook plugins with their state, cursor and dead letters | `read`, idempotent yes | daemon | operator | none: the hooks service's runners and dead-letter store | - |
| `heo hook replay` | Queue delivering the event log to a plugin again from a position | `write-local`, idempotent yes, dry-run | daemon | operator | Events.List as the plugin; queues a job that runs the plugin and applies its operations | - |
| `heo hook test` | Run a plugin on one stored event and show its result, applying nothing | `read`, idempotent yes | daemon | operator | Events.Get as the plugin; runs the plugin, applies nothing | - |

### service

| Verb | Does | Effect | Runs in | Roles | uma | Limit |

```sh
# Which services exist, are enabled and are ready
heo service list
# JSON for agents

# Drain and re-execute the running daemon
heo service restart
# Give the new instance longer to become ready
heo service restart --wait 5m
# See the plan, change nothing

# Enable REST and MCP on loopback
heo service setup api mcp
# Pick the address
heo service setup rpc --addr rpc=127.0.0.1:9082
# Replace the token and print the new one
heo service setup --rotate-token --show-token
# See the plan, write nothing
heo service setup api --dry-run
# Run every enabled service in the foreground
heo service start
# Run one service, enabled or not
heo service start socket
# Enable another service for this run
heo service start --enable webhook
# Which services the running daemon started and whether they are ready
heo service status
# JSON for agents
heo service status --format json
# Drain the running daemon
heo service stop
# Give the drain longer
heo service stop --wait 3m
# See the plan, change nothing
heo service stop --dry-run
```

### spec

| Verb | Does | Effect | Runs in | Roles | uma | Limit |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `heo spec` | Emit machine-readable capability manifest | `read`, idempotent yes | local | none (offline) | none: kit toolspec | - |

```sh
heo spec coverage --min 80
```

| `heo storage migrate` | Bring the profile's data store to this binary's schema | `write`, idempotent yes, dry-run | local | host user | none: storage driver (takes store ownership) | - |
| `heo storage restore` | Replace the profile's data store and attachments with a backup | `destructive-local`, idempotent yes, dry-run | local | host user | none: storage driver (takes store ownership) | local only |
| `heo storage status` | Show heo, kit, uma and store versions and schema compatibility | `read`, idempotent yes | local | host user | none: storage driver | - |

```sh
# Basic use

# Basic use
```

### task

| Verb | Does | Effect | Runs in | Roles | uma | Limit |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `heo task cancel` | Cancel a task, answering the remote agent's cancel request | `write-shared`, idempotent conditional, dry-run | daemon | desk | Tasks.Act | - |
| `heo task get` | Show one task | `read`, idempotent yes | daemon | desk, viewer | Tasks.Get | - |
| `heo task list` | List the tasks of your agent inboxes, most recent status first | `read`, idempotent yes | daemon | desk, viewer | Tasks.List | - |
| `heo task watch` | Stream a task's events until it reaches a final state | `write`, idempotent yes, dry-run | daemon | desk | Events.Open, Events.Poll, Events.Ack, Events.Close | not on REST, gRPC or MCP |

```sh
# Preview with --dry-run, change nothing
heo task cancel task_123 --revision rev_9 --dry-run
# Safe to retry, with an idempotency key
heo task cancel task_123 --revision rev_9 --idempotency-key stop-42
# Basic use
heo task get task_123
# JSON for agents
heo task get task_123 --format json
# Basic use
heo task list
# With --status

# JSON for agents

# Basic use
heo task watch task_123
# JSON for agents

# With --consumer, --from
heo task watch task_123 --consumer ops --from beginning
```

### token

| Verb | Does | Effect | Runs in | Roles | uma | Limit |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `heo token claims` | Print a structured claims template (not a signed token) | `read`, idempotent yes | local | none (offline) | none: kit authentication | - |
| `heo token decode` | Decode and print JWT payload (no signature verification) | `read`, idempotent yes | local | none (offline) | none: kit authentication | - |
| `heo token verify` | Check a token as a service would accept it | `read`, idempotent yes | local | none (offline) | none: kit authentication | - |

```sh
# A claims template for an external signer
heo token claims --sub ada --scopes read,write --expires 1h
# Inspect a token's payload without verifying it
heo token decode <token>
# Verify a token against the api service's authentication
heo token verify <token>
# Against another service
heo token verify <token> --service mcp
```

## Grammar coverage

Every resource and verb of the grammar is in the tables above, or here with the reason it is not. A
row leaves this table when its verb ships; a test fails while a verb is in both places, and while a
verb is in neither.

| Verb | Status | Why |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `heo message search` | folded | `message list --text`, `--since`, `--until` and the label filters search; uma applies them |
| `heo channel enable` | cut | availability is the inbox's: `inbox enable` and `inbox disable` |
| `heo channel disable` | cut | availability is the inbox's: `inbox enable` and `inbox disable` |
| (per-inbox grants) | deferred | after v0.1: a grant names an actor and roles for the whole tenant, never one inbox |

Statuses: `deferred` waits on a uma capability that does not exist yet; `not built` is heo-side work
not done; `cut` was decided against; `folded` is served by another verb.
